name: replace-me
objective: State the task outcome and why it matters.

task_constraints.requirement: Copy one explicit scope, cost, time, authority, or acceptance limit from the task.
task_constraints.enforced_by: Name the node, state field, budget, or guard that enforces it.
task_constraints.on_violation: Name the terminal state or escalation path.

topology_decision.why_more_structure_is_needed: Name the distinct operation, authority, context, or repeated correction that justifies this design.

state.persistence: State what is checkpointed and when.
state.reset_boundary: State when accumulated state becomes invalid.

nodes.capability_evidence: Name the pilot, evaluation, or prior receipt.
nodes.authority: May change the draft; may not publish or message externally.
nodes.failure_policy: Return a typed blocked result and preserve the last checkpoint.

nodes.purpose: Extract observable evidence for the controller.
nodes.authority: May report; may not change the candidate result.
nodes.failure_policy: Fail closed and request human inspection.

edges.handoff_contract: candidate id, content hash, and claimed changes
edges.on_failure: block and surface the missing field

edges.guard: named defect remains and budget is available
edges.handoff_contract: defect id, evidence, and acceptance criterion
edges.on_failure: escalate with the last good checkpoint

loops.controlled_variable: distance from the declared acceptance criteria

sensor.name: replace-me
confounds: name at least one way the signal can mislead

loops.decision_rule: continue only when a named defect remains and the latest step added relevant evidence
loops.escalation: Send the last good state, the open criterion, and attempted actions.
loops.persistence: Checkpoint after every accepted state transition.

dynamic_topology.hysteresis: Not applicable while the topology is fixed.
dynamic_topology.promotion_gate: Shadow recommendations must beat the fixed route under matched budget before activation.

evaluation.link_a_sensor: Compare sensor calls with an independent criterion.
evaluation.link_b_policy: Hold the sensor fixed and compare action menus or policies.
evaluation.link_c_outcome: Compare task outcome, cost, latency, and risk with the simpler baseline.
evaluation.matched_baseline: Repeat the baseline named in topology_decision.

prompt_contracts.generator: Perform the object-level task and report what changed.
prompt_contracts.sensor: Extract observable evidence and uncertainty without choosing the next action.
prompt_contracts.controller: Choose from the declared action menu using the sensor report, authority limits, and remaining budget.
